steps.name: pin_14b
steps.cmd: mkdir -p /tmp/pinwork && HF_XET_CHUNK_CACHE_SIZE_BYTES=0 PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/pin_model_fingerprints.py qwen2.5-14b-instruct --prefetch 1 --work /tmp/pinwork > /tmp/pin_14b.out; rc=$?; cat /tmp/pin_14b.out >> /kaggle/working/pins.jsonl; cat /tmp/pin_14b.out; df -h /tmp; du -sh ~/.cache/huggingface 2>/dev/null; rm -rf ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--Qwen--*; exit $rc

steps.name: pin_14b_write
steps.cmd: mkdir -p /tmp/pinwork && HF_XET_CHUNK_CACHE_SIZE_BYTES=0 PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/pin_model_fingerprints.py qwen2.5-14b-instruct --write-pack --compare-packer --work /tmp/pinwork > /tmp/pin_14b_write.out; rc=$?; cat /tmp/pin_14b_write.out >> /kaggle/working/pins.jsonl; cat /tmp/pin_14b_write.out; df -h /tmp; du -sh ~/.cache/huggingface 2>/dev/null; rm -rf ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--Qwen--*; exit $rc
